note: Candidate tags in priority order, checked against SEC data for the ten configured companies, fiscal 2022 to 2025 (see docs/verification.md). 'core': false marks supporting fields that are excluded from the seven-metric headline count.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Consolidated total revenue for the fiscal year
metrics.rationale: Revenues comes first because Walmart reports both tags with different values: Revenues is total revenue, while the contract tag is net sales without membership and other income. Where the other companies report both tags for a year, the values agree. SalesRevenueNet was dropped because it matched no year in scope. Tags are never added together.

metrics.name: net_income
metrics.description: Net income attributable to the parent company
metrics.rationale: NetIncomeLoss is the parent-attributable figure. ProfitLoss includes noncontrolling interests and is not a substitute.

metrics.name: total_assets
metrics.description: Total assets at fiscal year end

metrics.name: total_liabilities
metrics.description: Total liabilities at fiscal year end
metrics.rationale: AMZN, KO and WMT have no Liabilities fact and print no such subtotal on the balance sheets checked. The value stays missing; it is not derived silently.

metrics.name: shareholders_equity
metrics.description: Equity attributable to the parent company at fiscal year end
metrics.rationale: Excludes noncontrolling interests, matching the NetIncomeLoss numerator for return on equity. PG reports only total equity including noncontrolling interests, so this stays missing for PG.

metrics.name: operating_cash_flow
metrics.description: Net cash from operating activities for the fiscal year

metrics.name: diluted_eps
metrics.description: Diluted earnings per share for the fiscal year
metrics.rationale: Never combined with basic EPS. Stock splits can cause later filings to restate earlier years.

metrics.name: total_equity_including_nci
metrics.description: Total equity including noncontrolling interests (supporting field)
metrics.rationale: Used only in the accounting identity check. Does not replace parent equity.

metrics.name: noncontrolling_interest
metrics.description: Equity owned by minority holders of subsidiaries (supporting field)
metrics.rationale: Explains the difference between total and parent equity.

metrics.name: redeemable_noncontrolling_interest
metrics.description: Noncontrolling interest shown between liabilities and equity (supporting field)
metrics.rationale: Reported by WMT and TSLA. Assets do not equal liabilities plus equity without it.
